newsitem.title: UK: Maxwell administrators raise repayment estimate.
newsitem.headline: Maxwell administrators raise repayment estimate.

text.p: Price Waterhouse, administrators of Maxwell Communication Corporation Plc (MMC), on Tuesday announced a further increase in the total repayment to its creditors to "approximately 47 to 52 percent".
In addition they would also receive any proceeds of remaining recovery actions, the administrators of Robert Maxwell's failed media empire said in a statement.
"The administrators remain of the view that it is inappropriate and not in creditors' interests to publish any estimate of the likely outcome of recovery actions."
The estimate compared with a predicted 44 to 48 percent dividend in the administrator's last report, released in July last year.

Price Waterhouse said that since the last report it had made fifth and sixth dividend payments to unsecured creditors of 5.0 percent and 2.5 percent respectively, "bringing cumulative dividends paid to agreed Scheme Creditors to 42 percent of their claims before Scheme interest".
